name: PunisherBanna
overview: Zufällige Filme und Serien als Banner auf der Jellyfin-Startseite.
description: Zeigt zufällige Filme oder Serien aus einer ausgewählten Bibliothek als anklickbaren Banner-Slider an.

versions.changelog: Adds compatibility with Jellyfin Server 12.1 and rebuilds the plugin against the Jellyfin 12.1 API packages. Existing banner modes, sizing controls, and settings remain unchanged.

Extends the custom centered banner-width slider down to 45 percent, approximately matching the visible complete video width on a large banner. Logo, fallback title, media type, and rating now move with the centered banner and adapt to the available width so they are not clipped at narrow settings.

Adds an optional custom centered banner-width mode with a 70 to 100 percent slider and live preview. Existing installations retain their current width until the new mode is enabled. The setting is available in English and German and works independently of banner size and complete-media framing.

Adds an optional complete-media banner mode that keeps the selected banner size while showing the entire image and full video or trailer without cropping. Softly blurred artwork fills unused space, the existing cropped fill mode remains the default, and the new setting is available in English and German.

Removes the explanatory sentence below the settings language selector for a cleaner layout. English remains the default, German remains selectable, and the saved bilingual settings behavior is unchanged.

Adds a persistent English/German language selector to the PunisherBanna settings page, with English as the default. All labels, descriptions, option values, live volume text, dependency status messages, and error dialogs switch immediately and the administrator's choice is saved in the plugin configuration.
